feedback_text: The dashboard won't load and I can't access any of my data.
It would be really useful if we could export reports directly to Excel.
I can't figure out where to add a new team member. The settings are confusing.
The new dashboard is much easier to use. I really like the updated layout.
Our CRM connection keeps disconnecting and we have to reconnect it manually
Every report export ends with an error today. We cannot send the weekly performance pack to our clients.
Could you let us schedule reports to arrive by email every Monday morning?
The billing page shows our old address even after I save the new one. I can still download invoices but have to request corrections.
The onboarding checklist helped our team finish setup without needing a training call.
The dashboard numbers look different this week. I'm not sure whether something changed or we are looking at them differently.
New users get an expired invitation message immediately after we invite them. Our new analysts cannot sign in to start work.
We need a read-only role for external reviewers so they can check reports without changing anything.
Finding an invoice takes too many clicks. A link from the account menu would save a little time.
The new sync history makes it easy to see which records were imported. It saved us a lot of troubleshooting this month.
Setup took longer than we expected. We got there eventually but I'm not sure we did everything the right way.
The platform signs everyone out as soon as they open a project. Our operations team has been unable to process today's work.
It would be helpful to pin our most-used projects to the top of the home page.
The date filter resets whenever I return from a report. I can reselect it but doing that all afternoon gets frustrating.
Being able to duplicate a report has cut our monthly preparation time in half.
The permissions feel a bit too open for our team. We may just need someone to walk us through the options.
Our payment went through but the account still says overdue and blocks access to every project. We cannot complete our client deliveries.
Could the onboarding guide include a sample project that we can explore before importing our own data?
The integration field names are hard to match to our internal labels. We worked it out but a preview of sample values would help.
Search is noticeably faster now. I can find old projects during calls without keeping people waiting.
The new report layout is interesting. Our team is still deciding whether it fits the way we share updates.
The initial data import stays at 99 percent and never finishes. We cannot start using the workspace until our records are available.
Please add an option to send billing receipts to a second email address so our bookkeeper receives a copy.
Removing access for departing team members is much clearer now. The confirmation screen helps us check that we selected the right person.
The connection seems quiet lately. There may simply be fewer updates coming through but I expected to see more activity.
Could we choose a different accent colour for dashboard charts? The current palette works but matching our presentation theme would be nice.
